findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, read_page, ask_expert · Private data: about_site, ask_expert · Public sink: ask_expert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, read_page, ask_expert · Private data: about_site, ask_expert · Public sink: ask_expert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
